pr.body:
Add a device-aware transfer backend layer for the Mooncake Store connector so dense-attention KV offloading also runs on Ascend:

* new transfer_backend.py: TransferBackend abstraction with CudaTransferBackend (kept identical to the original H200 behavior) and AscendTransferBackend, which creates an external TransferEngine and injects it into the store via setup(..., engine=...), then registers NPU HBM with engine.register_memory -- direct HBM transfers with no D2H/H2D staging, mirroring vllm-ascend ascend_store.
* worker.py: resolve the backend from extra_config (device_backend: auto/cuda/ascend) and delegate store setup, buffer registration, ready-event creation and shutdown to it.
* data.py: accept protocol=ascend in MooncakeStoreConfig.

Verified on a3_dev2 (Ascend910_9392): store.setup ret=0, HBM register_memory ret=0, batch_put ret=0, batch_is_exist=1, batch_get roundtrip data match.
